# Title

> Forestimator Web is the cartographic portal of the forstry section of Uliege Agro Bio Tech Gembloux.
Many of our work results in a map. To put them at disposal of the public, we have created this web portal. 

It allows to visualize and download forest maps and data of the Walloon Region. 

It allows to make analysis of points or areas of interest, and to create and download reports.

It allows to consult the Belgium Cadasteral data.
